sections.text: Disassembly of the Filter

Remove the drop nose bolt (5)
and the bridge (3).

Lift the cover (2) from the
filter body (1).

Remove the basket (12) by
basket handle.

Place a clean rag or other
material over the filter to prevent ingress of dust or dirt during the basket cleaning.

The 
basket should be washed down using suitable solvent and immersing in a large 
tank then dry by air.

Remove the O ring seal (10)
from the body and clean it.
